ICS 81.040.20; 27.160CHD 10New Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard (Part 3) prescribes the requirements, method of sampling and tests for safety glass for use in solar applications. This includes both photovoltaic panels and solar flat plate collectors.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:1382 : 1981 Glossary of terms related to glass and glassware ( first revision )2303 (Part 1/Sec 2) : 2012 Grading glass: Part 1 Method of test and classification, Section 2 Hydrolytic resistance of glass grains at 121Â°C ( second revision )2553 (Part 1) : 2018 Safety glass - Specification: Part 1 Architectural, building and general uses ( fourth revision )4905 : 2015 Random sampling and randomization procedures ( first revision)14286 : 2010 Crystalline silicon terrestrial photovoltaic (PV) modules - Design qualification and type approval ( first revision )14900 : 2018 Transparent float glass - Specification ( first revision )16231 (Part 2) : 2019 Use of glass in building - Code of practice: Part 2 Energy and light ( first revision )17004 : 2018 Testing methods for processed glass
